I can understand Silviana perfectly. In fact, Silviana is one of the most solid and nice characters in the series, in my opinion. Yes, I, a Blue, speaking like this, of a Red. She is highly intelligent, extremely fair-minded and shockingly loyal to what she believes in. The absolute, unshatterable proof of Silviana's loyalty was when she asked Egwene to pass the mortally wounded Gawyn's bond to her. A Red. Bonding a man she absolutely despises. That's loyalty. 

As for the entire Trakand family, Morgase is the only one I can approve of a hundred percent. Elayne is shockingly naïve and stubborn, something even Nynaeve can comment on in a non-hypocritic way, which say something. And Gawyn... Not even going to start on that one. I'll just put it like this: Egwene is super smart most of the time, but just like there's a blind spot of hatred for the Seanchan in her mind, there is a blind spot of love for Gawyn. I find him detestable, and I have no idea how Egwene was thinking. She could have taken Galad, wouldn't that have been a nice plot twist? The Amyrlin Seat marrying the Lord Captain Commander of the Whitecloaks? I giggle at this thought. Then again, Min's viewing of the two most beautiful people in the world falling in love wouldn't have come true, crappy enough. I would have been fine with handing Gawyn over to Berelain. Hmpf.
